{{Quote|If you're going to find these artifacts, you'll need a ship and so I have ordered you one. All you need to do is pick it up.|Darth Zash|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] later known as [[Darth Nox]] was given a '''[[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptor]]''' by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] master, [[Darth Zash]], during the search for the artifacts of [[Tulak Hord]]. Kallig, as the Sith was first known, continued to use the ship even after leaving Zash's apprenticeship.
